fluff.overview: Drawing veterans from the Com Guards, recruits from the Free Worlds League, and volunteers from Protectorate worlds, the Word of Blake Militia assembled infantry formations whose quality varied but whose equipment was consistently first-rate. Motorized Level I formations used light vehicles for rapid movement between garrison posts, providing the speed needed to respond to civil unrest or insurgent attacks faster than foot infantry could march. Their mobility made them a preferred choice for patrol duties across the Word's Protectorate holdings. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
